note: Add one object per chat, newest first. Fields: topic, title, role (who, without a name unless they are happy to be named), learned (what I took away), why (why it matters), date (e.g. Oct 2026, optional).

chats.title: There is a whole market for carbon
chats.learned: I did not know carbon had its own market until this chat. Emissions are turned into something that can be priced and traded: a credit stands for one tonne of carbon dioxide avoided or removed, and companies buy and sell them.
chats.why: It changed how I read industry news. Energy, forestry and heavy industry are not only about what they produce. What they emit can show up on their income statement too.
